visual.description: Vertical tabs showing three actionable steps the viewer can take. Each tab reveals on click/auto-advance with a title and short description. Accent Pink active indicator. Dot-grid background for data-feel, frosted-panel surface for depth. Text stays in upper 65% for YouTube end screen safety.

items.title: Check the Label
items.description: Look for fabric composition before buying. Choose certified natural fibers or tested blends to reduce chemical exposure.

items.title: Wash Before Wearing
items.description: A single pre-wash removes ~61% of residual formaldehyde (emission drops from 107 to 42 μg/m²/h). Always wash new clothes before wearing.

items.title: Look for Oeko-Tex / GOTS
items.description: These certifications guarantee tested limits on harmful substances. Oeko-Tex Standard 100 is the most widely recognized.

notes: CTA section — three actionable steps as vertical tabs. Uses VerticalTabScene template. Active tab indicator uses Accent Pink (#E88CA5), inactive tabs use Warm Cream at reduced opacity. No Sage as accent — only for dot-grid background. Tabs auto-advance with staggered reveal timing.
